purpose: Reduce shadow crawling, contact detachment, jagged thin geometry and LOD instability without hiding defects in post-processing, while proving the same stable shadow state survives every generated-scene solar/environment reapplication.

summerSun.notes: Bias is deliberately constrained: excessive bias creates peter-panning/light leaks, while insufficient bias creates self-shadow acne. Source settings and solar math are implementation evidence only; final acceptance is render-based.

strategy: no post sharpen used to manufacture edge detail

temporalAndLod.cameraMotionAcceptance: No visible LOD pop, severe shadow crawl or geometry shimmer in actual moving-camera verification.
temporalAndLod.stillFrameAcceptance: 100% crops must not show objectionable stair-stepping on hero rails, sash, grating or branch silhouettes.

enforcement.saveBehavior: The legacy shadow save gate reapplies the stable shadow policy. The solar/shadow save gate then requires the physical context, sole SummerSun, runtime contract and bound MainCamera pre-cull guard before the contextualized benchmark scene can save.
enforcement.captureChainRelationship: Environment/weathering passes can reapply SummerSun during generated-scene construction. QualityBlockEnvironmentContext now reapplies the same stable shadow state at that moment; both save gates persist/validate it, and the pre-cull guard validates it again immediately before MainCamera culling for Camera.Render.
enforcement.previousTransientWriterMismatch: The environment context formerly wrote per-light bias 0.04/0.28 while the shadow pass used 0.025/0.38. The existing shadow save gate repaired this on save, so it was not an unguarded final-capture state; the new shared runtime contract removes the transient writer mismatch and adds independent pre-render verification.

visualFidelityGateMapping.lightingShadowsReflections: Potential impact only until render review: contact integrity, shadow direction coherence, cascade stability and absence of light leaks.
visualFidelityGateMapping.temporalLodAliasingStability: Potential impact only until render review: silhouette edge quality, shadow shimmer and LOD transitions.

forbiddenShortcuts: Painted or baked contact shadows/highlights used as a substitute for light transport
Post sharpening used to fake missing geometry or texture fidelity
Excessive blur used to conceal aliasing
Shadow bias increased until real contacts visibly detach
Transparent window planes casting opaque card shadows
Selecting the strongest directional light while silently allowing a second contradictory key
Claiming stable 4K quality without an actual Unity render
